title: Copilot Studio: discover and add skills from the skills catalog
summary: The briefing distinguishes roadmap plans from the documented preview and accurately gives the package controls, sharing route and billing caveats. One minor correction should acknowledge that Microsoft's What's new page describes broader sharing than the detailed skill-sharing instructions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Copilot Studio skills catalog for makers to discover and add organisational skills.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog

claims.claim: Makers can reuse skills instead of recreating instructions and workflows for every agent.
claims.quote: makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent

claims.claim: The planned catalog enables selective sharing of approved organisational skills.
claims.quote: makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills

claims.claim: The shared catalog is powered by Microsoft 365 App Store.
claims.quote: The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store

claims.claim: The roadmap describes skills extending across Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.
claims.quote: enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork

claims.claim: The roadmap describes maintaining centralised governance.
claims.quote: helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the planned catalog by that name, so catalog-specific details rest on the roadmap.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog"; opened skills-manage, skills-overview, skills-add-existing and package overview. Results describe shared-skill browsing and package catalogs, without identifying the roadmap catalog by name.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The planned catalog's state on arrival is not stated, represented by unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "Browse skills" "default"; Copilot Studio "skills catalog" default admin enable disable roles approval. Read the record, skills-manage and skills-copilot-studio-rule; none states the planned catalog's arrival default.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether an administrator must act for the planned catalog.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "skills catalog" default admin enable disable roles approval; "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog" "approval" "arrival". Read record, skills-manage and skills-copilot-studio-rule; no catalog-specific mandatory admin action was stated.

claims.quote: Select the Build tab. ... Select the + icon next to Skills, and then select Browse skills (preview). ... Select the skill you want to add. ... On the skill details page, select Add.

claims.claim: Available shared skills are those shared by admins or skill owners.
claims.quote: The skills available to you are the ones shared by admins or skill owners.

claims.claim: A skill is a name, description and instructions that guide an agent's handling of a task.
claims.quote: A skill is a capability defined by a name, a description, and instructions that tell the agent how to handle specific types of tasks or scenarios.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support

claims.claim: Makers receive an update notification when opening an agent that uses an older shared-skill version.
claims.quote: You receive a skill update notification when you open an agent that uses an older version of a shared skill.

claims.claim: The detailed sharing instructions offer Only you or Specific users or groups in your organization.

claims.fix: After the sharing-options sentence, add: "The What's new page also describes sharing skills with the whole organisation, whereas the detailed sharing instructions list Only you and specific users or groups." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new#notable-changes, which says "share your own skills with specific people or your whole organization".

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: impact
claims.claim: People and groups a skill is shared with can add it to their agents.
claims.quote: The people and groups you share with can then add the skill to their agents.

claims.claim: An owner must share an edited skill again to make the changes available to existing recipients.
claims.quote: When you edit and change a skill that you already shared, share the skill again to make the latest version available to those you previously shared it with.

claims.claim: Editing and resharing makes a newer skill version available.
claims.quote: share the skill again to make the latest version available ... You can choose to update to the new version

claims.claim: A skill package can include supporting scripts, templates and reference documents.
claims.quote: The package can optionally include supporting files, such as scripts, templates, and reference documents.

claims.claim: The runtime activates a skill based on the user's message and skill description rather than requiring an explicit request by name.
claims.quote: The orchestration runtime decides when to activate a skill based on the user's message and the skill's description.

claims.claim: A skill can instruct an agent to use a specific tool.
claims.quote: For example, a skill might instruct your agent to use a specific tool in a particular way.

claims.claim: The shared-skill Learn page does not specify what data a catalog skill can reach.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "catalog" "skills" "data access". Read skills-manage, skills-overview and skills-add-existing; skills-manage describes adding, sharing and updating, not catalog-specific data-access boundaries.

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Browse skills" sharing tenant admin disable approval. Opened skills-manage, skills-copilot-studio-rule and manage-plugins-skills-mcp-servers; none documents a tenant switch for this maker sharing dialog.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document an approval step for adding a shared skill beyond the maker selecting Add.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Browse skills" sharing tenant admin disable approval; "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog" "approval" "arrival". Read skills-manage and package administration guidance; the shared-skill addition procedure ends at Add.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A licence specific to the skills catalog has not been published, distinct from harness billing and API licensing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio skills catalog license pricing browsing adding sharing Copilot Credits. Read skills-manage, billing-credit-overview and Package Management API overview; results give harness billing and API entitlement, not a catalog-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate rate for browsing, adding or sharing skills, or catalog-specific credit rate, is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio skills catalog license pricing browsing adding sharing Copilot Credits. Read skills-manage, skills-add-existing and billing-credit-overview; no browsing, adding, sharing or catalog-specific rate was given.

claims.claim: The consumption model reflects usage-based Copilot Credit billing for agents on the Microsoft Copilot harness, including those using shared skills.
claims.quote: Agents, workflows, and apps powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness ... use a usage-based billing structure. ... Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: The shared-skill instructions warn that using, building, testing and evaluating agents might consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: The harness used to build this agent uses usage-based billing. Using, building, testing, and evaluating agents might consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness billing starts when the maker starts building.
claims.quote: the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building

claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: Package user availability is managed at Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin or skill > Users > All users / No users / Specific users and groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools > Plugins. ... Open Users ... All users ... No users ... Specific users and groups ... Managing a skill uses the same actions and steps as managing a plugin

claims.quote: allowedUsersAndGroups ... Users/groups for whom the package is available.

claims.claim: The package update API is preview.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio shared skill sharing Dataverse table entity reference API permissions; "Copilot Studio" "skill" "share" "Power Platform API" "CLI". Read skills-manage and package references; no operation mapped to this maker sharing dialog.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly established that the general package availability, block and inventory controls govern the planned Copilot Studio catalog.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog"; Copilot Studio "Browse skills" sharing tenant admin disable approval. Read skills-manage, manage-plugins-skills-mcp-servers, administrator-guide and package overview; no explicit catalog-to-package mapping.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not explicitly identify Browse skills as the same catalog or store described by this roadmap item.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog". Read skills-manage, skills-overview, package overview and the roadmap record; none explicitly equates Browse skills with the roadmap's Microsoft 365 App Store-powered catalog.

claims.claim: Some skills, including those used in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, are stored in OneDrive rather than the plugin registry.
claims.quote: Don't assume every skill is stored in the plugin registry. Skills used in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint are stored in OneDrive today.

claims.claim: Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access in the Microsoft 365 admin center controls access to plugin publisher categories Microsoft, your organisation and certified external publishers.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access. ... choose which publisher categories users can access: Microsoft, your organization, or certified external publishers.

claims.claim: The skills overview describes two skill types for the Customer Conversation harness.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Customer Conversation harness support two types of skills: Generative skills ... and Topic skills

claims.claim: The shared-skill page does not explicitly enumerate which harnesses Browse skills covers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "Browse skills" "default"; Copilot Studio shared skill sharing Dataverse table entity reference API permissions. Read skills-manage and skills-overview; the Browse section gives a billing note but no explicit harness eligibility list.

claims.claim: Roles specific to administering the planned skills catalog are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "skills catalog" default admin enable disable roles approval; "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog" "administrator" "role". Read skills-manage, package administration and skills-copilot-studio-rule; no catalog-specific role requirement.

claims.claim: The cited plugin-management page names AI Administrator and Global Administrator for MCP request review and tenant consent, not as skill-management role requirements.
claims.quote: Review and approve MCP requests ... You must have access to the Tools page ... You must be able to grant tenant-wide consent. Two roles meet both requirements: AI Administrator ... Global Administrator.

claims.claim: No source states that the planned catalog changes existing agent behaviour on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "Browse skills" "default"; "Copilot Studio" "skills catalog" "approval" "arrival". Read roadmap, skills-manage and skills-overview; none describes an automatic modification to existing agents.

claims.claim: Variable cost is supported by the documented Copilot Credits meter.
claims.quote: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.
